summary: Descendants, spouse and parents are guaranteed a share of the estate that a will cannot remove. Kosovo has no trust law and is outside the Hague Trusts Convention. Foundations are non-profit bodies.
reserved_share: Descendants, spouse and parents are compulsory heirs under Law No. 2004/26 on Inheritance; the fractions (believed 1/2 of the intestate share) were not confirmed.
foreign_law_note: Kosovo has its own private international law act; whether a foreign national may choose their national law was not confirmed.
trust_note: No trust law. Foundations exist under the law on freedom of association in non-governmental organisations, for non-profit purposes.
open_questions: Statute article numbers and exact fractions for forced heirs outside descendants and spouse were not read in the primary text; confirm in the official gazette.
Whether a foreign national resident may choose a law for their estate under the current private international law act was not confirmed.
